Create and manage user-selectable post categories.

import { Tabs, TabItem } from '@astrojs/starlight/components'; Categories are user-facing classifications that submitters choose when creating a post (e.g. "Bug", "Feature Request", "Improvement"). A post can have only one category; users can set it themselves. ## Endpoints | Method | Path | Description | |--------|------|-------------| | GET | `/v1/categories` | List all categories | | POST | `/v1/categories` | Create a category | | DELETE | `/v1/categories/:id` | Delete a category | --- ## List categories
GET/v1/categories

import { Aside } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

The Feeduro API lets you read and write your product data from any external system — sync roadmap status, push user segments, build integrations, or automate changelog publishing.

## Base URL

```
https://app.feeduro.com/v1
```

All requests and responses use JSON. Every endpoint requires authentication — see [Authentication](/authentication). Want to try endpoints interactively? Jump to the [API Explorer](/api-explorer).

## Response format

**List endpoints**

```json title="List response shape"
{
  "data": [ { "id": "..." } ],
  "hasMore": true,
  "cursor": "eyIyMDI2LTA1LTMwVDEwOjAwOjAwLjAwMFoifQ"
}
```

**Single resource**

```json title="Single resource shape"
{
  "data": { "id": "..." }
}
```

**Errors**

```json title="Error shape"
{
  "error": "Human-readable message",
  "code": "machine_readable_code"
}
```

Validation errors (422) include per-field details:

```json title="Validation error"
{
  "error": "Validation failed",
  "code": "validation_error",
  "details": {
    "fieldErrors": { "title": ["Required"] },
    "formErrors": []
  }
}
```

## HTTP status codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| `200` | Success |
| `201` | Resource created |
| `400` | Bad request — invalid query parameters |
| `401` | Missing or invalid API key |
| `404` | Resource not found or outside your org |
| `405` | Method not allowed |
| `409` | Conflict — duplicate name, already voted, etc. |
| `422` | Validation error — check `details` for field errors |
| `429` | Rate limit exceeded (60 req/min per key) |

## Rate limits

The API enforces a limit of **60 requests per minute** per API key. When exceeded, all requests return `429 Too Many Requests` until the window resets.

```http title="429 response headers"
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 30
```

```json title="429 body"
{ "error": "Rate limit exceeded", "code": "rate_limit_exceeded" }
```

Respect the `Retry-After` header value (seconds) before retrying. For bulk operations, use cursor pagination's `limit: 100` to minimise round trips.

<Aside type="tip">
  All timestamps are ISO 8601 strings in UTC — e.g. `"2026-05-30T10:00:00.000Z"`. All IDs are CUID2 strings.
</Aside>
All list endpoints use cursor-based pagination with a consistent interface.

Returns all active (non-merged) posts grouped into status columns, sorted by `rank` ascending within each column, then `createdAt` descending for unranked posts. ### Parameters | Name | In | Type | Required | Description | |------|----|------|----------|-------------| | `status` | query | string | No | Limit to one column: `open` \| `reviewing` \| `planned` \| `in-progress` \| `completed` \| `closed` | ### Request ```bash # All columns curl https://app.feeduro.com/v1/roadmap \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" # Single column curl "https://app.feeduro.com/v1/roadmap?status=planned" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" ``` ```ts // All columns const res = await fetch('https://app.feeduro.com/v1/roadmap', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer YOUR_KEY' }, }); const { data: { columns } } = await res.json(); // Single column const res = await fetch('https://app.feeduro.com/v1/roadmap?status=planned', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer YOUR_KEY' }, }); ``` ### Responses ```json { "data": { "columns": { "open": [ { "id": "post_01aaa111", "title": "CSV export", "description": null, "status": "open", "rank": null, "voteCount": 12, "boardId": "board_01abc123", "categoryId": null, "createdAt": "2025-09-01T00:00:00.000Z", "updatedAt": "2025-09-01T00:00:00.000Z" } ], "reviewing": [], "planned": [], "in-progress": [], "completed": [], "closed": [] } } } ``` ```json { "data": { "columns": { "planned": [ { "id": "post_01xyz789", "title": "Dark mode support", "status": "planned" } ] } } } ``` ```json { "error": "Invalid query parameters", "code": "invalid_params", "details": { "fieldErrors": { "status": ["Invalid enum value"] }, "formErrors": [] } } ``` | Field | Type | Nullable | Description | |-------|------|----------|-------------| | `id` | string | No | Post ID | | `title` | string | No | Post title | | `description` | string | Yes | Post description | | `status` | string | No | Current column | | `rank` | number | Yes | Sort position — lower = higher. `null` = unranked (falls to bottom). | | `voteCount` | integer | No | Total vote count | | `boardId` | string | No | Board this post belongs to | | `categoryId` | string | Yes | Assigned category | | `createdAt` | string | No | ISO 8601 timestamp | | `updatedAt` | string | No | ISO 8601 timestamp | --- ## Update a post's status or rank
PATCH/v1/roadmap/posts/:id
Move a post to a different column or reorder it within its current column. At least one of `status` or `rank` is required.
**Rank arithmetic:** To insert between two posts with `rank: 1.0` and `rank: 2.0`, use `rank: 1.5`. Any float value works — there is no need to renumber existing posts.

Register HTTPS endpoints to receive real-time event notifications from Feeduro.

import { Tabs, TabItem, Aside } from '@astrojs/starlight/components'; Webhooks let you react to events in real time — send Slack notifications when feedback status changes, sync tasks to Linear when a post goes "in-progress", or update your changelog CMS when an entry is published. ## Supported events | Event | Fires when | |-------|------------| | `feedback.created` | A new post is submitted | | `feedback.status_changed` | A post's status is updated | | `comment.created` | A public comment is added to a post | | `changelog.created` | A changelog entry is created | | `changelog.published` | A changelog entry is published | Use `["*"]` to subscribe to all current and future events. ## Endpoints | Method | Path | Description | |--------|------|-------------| | GET | `/v1/webhooks` | List endpoints | | POST | `/v1/webhooks` | Create an endpoint | | GET | `/v1/webhooks/:id` | Get an endpoint | | PATCH | `/v1/webhooks/:id` | Update an endpoint | | DELETE | `/v1/webhooks/:id` | Delete an endpoint | --- ## Payload format Every delivery is a signed `POST` request to your URL: ```http title="Delivery headers" Content-Type: application/json X-Webhook-Event: feedback.created X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=a1b2c3d4e5f6... ``` ```json title="Payload body" { "event": "feedback.status_changed", "organizationId": "org_01aaa111", "data": { "id": "post_01xyz789", "oldStatus": "open", "newStatus": "planned", "changedBy": "user_01zzz999" }, "timestamp": "2026-05-30T10:00:00.000Z" } ``` ### Verifying the signature Validate every incoming webhook by recomputing the HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body using your endpoint's `secret`. ```ts title="Node.js / TypeScript verification" import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'crypto'; function verifyWebhook(rawBody: string, secret: string, signatureHeader: string): boolean { const expected = 'sha256=' + createHmac('sha256', secret).update(rawBody).digest('hex'); const actual = Buffer.from(signatureHeader); const expectedBuf = Buffer.from(expected); if (actual.length !== expectedBuf.length) return false; return timingSafeEqual(actual, expectedBuf); } ```
Always verify the signature before processing the payload. Feeduro retries deliveries that receive a non-2xx response up to 3 times with exponential backoff.
--- ## List endpoints
GET/v1/webhooks
The `secret` is **never returned** from list or get endpoints. ### Parameters _No parameters._ ### Request ```bash curl https://app.feeduro.com/v1/webhooks \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" ``` ```ts const res = await fetch('https://app.feeduro.com/v1/webhooks', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer YOUR_KEY' }, }); const { data } = await res.json(); ``` ### Responses ```json { "data": [ { "id": "wh_01aaa111", "name": "Production webhook", "url": "https://example.com/feeduro/events", "events": ["feedback.created", "feedback.status_changed"], "isActive": true, "createdAt": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z", "updatedAt": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z" } ] } ``` | Field | Type | Nullable | Description | |-------|------|----------|-------------| | `id` | string | No | Unique endpoint ID | | `name` | string | Yes | Optional display label | | `url` | string | No | HTTPS delivery URL | | `events` | string[] | No | Subscribed event names, or `["*"]` for all | | `isActive` | boolean | No | `false` = deliveries paused | | `createdAt` | string | No | ISO 8601 timestamp | | `updatedAt` | string | No | ISO 8601 timestamp | --- ## Create an endpoint
POST/v1/webhooks
Maximum **10 endpoints** per organization. URL must use HTTPS. ### Parameters | Name | In | Type | Required | Description | |------|----|------|----------|-------------| | `url` | body | string | Yes | HTTPS URL — HTTP is rejected | | `name` | body | string | No | Human-readable label (max 100 chars) | | `events` | body | string[] | No | Event names or `["*"]` — defaults to `["*"]` | ### Request ```bash curl -X POST https://app.feeduro.com/v1/webhooks \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "url": "https://example.com/feeduro/events", "name": "Production webhook", "events": ["feedback.created", "feedback.status_changed"] }' ``` ```ts const res = await fetch('https://app.feeduro.com/v1/webhooks', { method: 'POST', headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer YOUR_KEY', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', }, body: JSON.stringify({ url: 'https://example.com/feeduro/events', name: 'Production webhook', events: ['feedback.created', 'feedback.status_changed'], }), }); const { data } = await res.json(); // Save data.secret — it won't be shown again ``` ### Responses ```json { "data": { "id": "wh_01aaa111", "name": "Production webhook", "url": "https://example.com/feeduro/events", "events": ["feedback.created", "feedback.status_changed"], "isActive": true, "secret": "a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2", "createdAt": "2026-05-30T10:00:00.000Z", "updatedAt": "2026-05-30T10:00:00.000Z" } } ``` ```json { "error": "Resource limit reached", "code": "limit_reached" } ``` ```json { "error": "Validation failed", "code": "validation_error", "details": { "fieldErrors": { "url": ["URL must use HTTPS"] }, "formErrors": [] } } ```
The `secret` is returned **only on creation**. Store it in a secure secret manager immediately — it cannot be retrieved again. If lost, delete and recreate the endpoint.
--- ## Get an endpoint
GET/v1/webhooks/:id
The `secret` is never returned. ### Parameters | Name | In | Type | Required | Description | |------|----|------|----------|-------------| | `id` | path | string | Yes | Webhook endpoint ID | ### Request ```bash curl https://app.feeduro.com/v1/webhooks/wh_01aaa111 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" ``` ```ts const res = await fetch('https://app.feeduro.com/v1/webhooks/wh_01aaa111', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer YOUR_KEY' }, }); const { data } = await res.json(); ``` ### Responses ```json { "data": { "id": "wh_01aaa111", "name": "Production webhook", "url": "https://example.com/feeduro/events", "events": ["feedback.created", "feedback.status_changed"], "isActive": true, "createdAt": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z", "updatedAt": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z" } } ``` ```json { "error": "Resource not found", "code": "not_found" } ``` --- ## Update an endpoint
PATCH/v1/webhooks/:id
All fields are optional — send only what you want to change. ### Parameters | Name | In | Type | Required | Description | |------|----|------|----------|-------------| | `id` | path | string | Yes | Webhook endpoint ID | | `url` | body | string | No | New HTTPS delivery URL | | `name` | body | string \| null | No | Set to `null` to clear the label | | `events` | body | string[] | No | Replace event subscriptions entirely | | `isActive` | body | boolean | No | `false` to pause, `true` to resume | ### Request ```bash # Pause deliveries curl -X PATCH https://app.feeduro.com/v1/webhooks/wh_01aaa111 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "isActive": false }' ``` ```ts await fetch('https://app.feeduro.com/v1/webhooks/wh_01aaa111', { method: 'PATCH', headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer YOUR_KEY', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', }, body: JSON.stringify({ isActive: false }), }); ``` ### Responses ```json { "success": true } ``` ```json { "error": "Resource not found", "code": "not_found" } ``` ```json { "error": "Validation failed", "code": "validation_error", "details": { "fieldErrors": { "url": ["URL must use HTTPS"] }, "formErrors": [] } } ``` --- ## Delete an endpoint

This guide walks you through the minimal end-to-end flow: authenticate, find a board, identify a user, and submit feedback on their behalf.

<Aside type="tip">
  You need a Feeduro API key. [Create one here](https://app.feeduro.com/settings/api-keys) — it takes 30 seconds.
</Aside>

---

<Steps>

1. ## Verify authentication

   List your boards to confirm your key works. Every subsequent call follows this same pattern.

   <Tabs>
     <TabItem label="curl">
       ```bash
       curl https://app.feeduro.com/v1/boards \
         -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY"
       ```
     </TabItem>
     <TabItem label="TypeScript">
       ```ts
       const res = await fetch('https://app.feeduro.com/v1/boards', {
         headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer YOUR_KEY' },
       });
       const { data } = await res.json();
       console.log(data); // [{ id: "board_01...", name: "Feature Requests", ... }]
       ```
     </TabItem>
   </Tabs>

   ```json title="Response"
   {
     "data": [
       { "id": "board_01abc123", "name": "Feature Requests", "postCount": 42 }
     ]
   }
   ```

   Copy the `id` of the board you want to post to — you'll need it in step 3.

2. ## Identify a user

   Before submitting feedback on a user's behalf, upsert their profile. Pass back the `id` — you need it for posts and votes.

   <Tabs>
     <TabItem label="curl">
       ```bash
       curl -X POST https://app.feeduro.com/v1/users/identify \
         -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" \
         -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
         -d '{
           "email": "alice@example.com",
           "name": "Alice",
           "plan": "pro"
         }'
       ```
     </TabItem>
     <TabItem label="TypeScript">
       ```ts
       const res = await fetch('https://app.feeduro.com/v1/users/identify', {
         method: 'POST',
         headers: {
           Authorization: 'Bearer YOUR_KEY',
           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
         },
         body: JSON.stringify({ email: 'alice@example.com', name: 'Alice', plan: 'pro' }),
       });
       const { data } = await res.json();
       const userId = data.id; // "up_01zzz999"
       ```
     </TabItem>
   </Tabs>

   ```json title="Response"
   { "data": { "id": "up_01zzz999" } }
   ```

3. ## Submit feedback

   Create a post on the board using the `boardId` from step 1.

   <Tabs>
     <TabItem label="curl">
       ```bash
       curl -X POST https://app.feeduro.com/v1/posts \
         -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" \
         -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
         -d '{
           "boardId": "board_01abc123",
           "title": "Dark mode support",
           "description": "Add a dark mode toggle to the dashboard"
         }'
       ```
     </TabItem>
     <TabItem label="TypeScript">
       ```ts
       const res = await fetch('https://app.feeduro.com/v1/posts', {
         method: 'POST',
         headers: {
           Authorization: 'Bearer YOUR_KEY',
           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
         },
         body: JSON.stringify({
           boardId: 'board_01abc123',
           title: 'Dark mode support',
           description: 'Add a dark mode toggle to the dashboard',
         }),
       });
       const { data } = await res.json();
       const postId = data.id; // "post_01xyz789"
       ```
     </TabItem>
   </Tabs>

   ```json title="Response"
   {
     "data": {
       "id": "post_01xyz789",
       "title": "Dark mode support",
       "status": "open",
       "voteCount": 0
     }
   }
   ```

4. ## Cast a vote

   Attach the user's vote to the post using the `userId` from step 2 and the `postId` from step 3.

   <Tabs>
     <TabItem label="curl">
       ```bash
       curl -X POST https://app.feeduro.com/v1/votes \
         -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" \
         -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
         -d '{
           "postId": "post_01xyz789",
           "userId": "up_01zzz999"
         }'
       ```
     </TabItem>
     <TabItem label="TypeScript">
       ```ts
       await fetch('https://app.feeduro.com/v1/votes', {
         method: 'POST',
         headers: {
           Authorization: 'Bearer YOUR_KEY',
           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
         },
         body: JSON.stringify({ postId: 'post_01xyz789', userId: 'up_01zzz999' }),
       });
       ```
     </TabItem>
   </Tabs>

   ```json title="Response"
   {
     "data": {
       "id": "vote_01aaa111",
       "postId": "post_01xyz789",
       "userId": "up_01zzz999",
       "voterName": "Alice"
     }
   }
   ```

5. ## You're done

   The post is live on your board with one vote. From here you can:

   - Subscribe to [webhooks](/webhooks) to react when post status changes
   - Read the [roadmap](/roadmap) to build a custom roadmap view
   - Use [changelog](/changelog) to publish release notes programmatically
   - See [recipes](/recipes) for complete integration patterns

</Steps>

## Rate limits

| Limit | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Requests per minute | **60 per API key** |
| Response header when exceeded | `Retry-After: <seconds>` |

When the limit is exceeded you receive `429 Too Many Requests`. Read the `Retry-After` header and wait that many seconds before retrying.

To stay within the limit during bulk operations: use `limit: 100` (maximum page size) to minimize round trips, and add a small delay between paginated requests when iterating large datasets.

---

## Resource limits

| Resource | Limit |
|----------|-------|
| Webhook endpoints per org | **10** |

---

## Field length limits

| Resource | Field | Max length |
|----------|-------|-----------|
| Post | `title` | 500 characters |
| Post | `description` | 10,000 characters |
| Comment | `body` | 10,000 characters |
| Tag | `name` | 100 characters |
| Category | `name` | 100 characters |
| Changelog entry | `title` | 500 characters |
| Webhook endpoint | `name` | 100 characters |
| User profile | `name`, `plan`, `role`, `industry`, `location` | No documented limit |

---

## Pagination limits

| Parameter | Default | Maximum |
|-----------|---------|---------|
| `limit` | 25 | 100 |

Requesting more than 100 results per page returns a `422` validation error.

---

## URL constraints

| Constraint | Details |
|-----------|---------|
| Webhook endpoint URL | Must use **HTTPS** — HTTP URLs are rejected with a `422` |

---

## Nesting constraints

| Resource | Constraint |
|----------|-----------|
| Comment replies | One level deep — replies cannot have their own replies |
| Post tags | No documented per-post maximum |
| Post categories | One category per post |

---

  Limits may change. Check this page or the [changelog](/changelog) when building integrations that approach these boundaries.
